title: Storyboard first when none is supplied
prompt: I have a scene and no storyboard yet. MIRA (30s, green wool coat, wet dark hair) comes home at night and finds a sealed envelope on the kitchen counter. She hesitates, then picks it up. DANIEL, her husband, appears in the doorway and says: "You weren't supposed to be home yet." Mira says nothing and keeps looking at the envelope. I want to generate this with Seedance in 6-second clips. Please help me get started.
rubric: Proposes numbered storyboard panels with beats, shot sizes, durations that fit 6-second clips, who is in frame and how each panel ends. Keeps Daniel's line exact. Stops for approval or says it will wait, and does not write finished video prompts yet.

title: Approved storyboard to Seedance prompts
prompt:
These storyboard panels are approved. Write the Seedance prompts, one per panel.

Panel 1 (6 s): Medium shot, locked off. MIRA (green wool coat, wet dark hair) steps into a dark kitchen and sets her keys on the counter. She notices a sealed envelope. Ends on her hand hovering over it.
Panel 2 (6 s): Close-up on Mira's face. She decides not to open it yet. Ends on her lowering her eyes.
Panel 3 (6 s): Two-shot. DANIEL appears in the doorway. Mira turns toward him. Ends with both still.
rubric: One self-contained prompt per panel with camera, timed or ordered action, performance as visible behavior, an ending state, and continuity notes between panels. Uses Seedance conventions from the model file, does not invent limits, keeps one camera movement per shot, and does not add dialogue.

title: Exact dialogue and listener reaction (Indonesian lines)
prompt: Tulis prompt video untuk satu klip 8 detik di dalam mobil. Penumpang bernama MIRA berkata persis: "Kamu tahu soal surat itu." Pengemudi bernama DANIEL menjawab persis: "Aku nggak tahu apa-apa." Gunakan model Veo. Jangan ubah dialognya.
rubric: Both lines appear word for word in the original language, attributed to the right speaker, with delivery and mouth movement for the speaker and a physical reaction for the listener. No invented lines. The prompt fits 8 seconds and keeps one camera setup.

title: Multi-character actions assigned by name
prompt: Write a video prompt for a 7-second shot. In a narrow hallway, a woman in an ivory dress holds a folded letter against her chest. A man in a charcoal suit stands two meters away. A waiter in a white jacket passes in the background carrying a tray. She steps back and leaves through the front door while the man watches. No dialogue. Target model: Runway.
rubric: Every person is identified by their description every time, actions are assigned per person, the background waiter's movement is unobtrusive, and the ending state is stated. Respects the Runway prompt length documented in the model file and does not add audio.

title: Repair a prompt that produces frozen characters
prompt: This prompt keeps giving me a stiff character who just stares at the camera. Fix it and tell me what was wrong: "A beautiful woman sits at a table, sad, cinematic, 4k, ultra detailed, camera zooms in and pans left while she walks to the door."
rubric: Diagnoses the real faults: no action or progression, an emotion label instead of behavior, contradictory movement (sitting while walking), competing camera moves, filler words. Returns a corrected prompt with visible behavior, one camera move and an ending state, and explains the changes briefly.

title: Kling limits from the sourced file, by version
prompt: What's the longest clip I can make with Kling, and how do I reference my character image in the prompt? I want a 12-second Kling shot of a man opening a door.
rubric: Uses the Kling file: asks or states which Kling version it assumes, gives limits per version with the verification date (Kling 4.0 up to 30 seconds, Flash 20, 3.0 per its page), explains @id reference syntax for an image, and writes a 12-second prompt that fits the stated version. Does not state limits for versions the file did not read.

title: Veo prompt with sourced, dated limits
prompt: Write a 6-second Veo prompt for a woman reading a letter at a kitchen table. Tell me which limits or features you're relying on and how current that information is.
rubric: Uses the Veo file, mentions that Gemini Omni Flash and Flow lineups changed and asks or states which model and surface it assumed, gives the verification date, and writes a prompt of about 6 seconds with a continuous shot, camera, action, performance and ending state.

title: Continuity across three shots
prompt: Write prompts for these three shots as one sequence for Seedance. 1: Mira, in a green wool coat holding keys in her right hand, enters the kitchen. 2: She puts the keys on the counter and notices an envelope. 3: She picks up the envelope with her left hand and turns toward the doorway where Daniel is standing. Keep everything consistent.
rubric: Each prompt restates identity, wardrobe and prop state, shot 1 ends in the state shot 2 starts from, hands and props stay consistent (keys right hand, then counter, then envelope in left hand), light and positions are stable, and a short ledger or continuity notes are included.

title: Does not activate for unrelated requests
prompt: Write a four-line poem about autumn rain.
rubric: Writes the poem and does not load the video prompt skill.

title: Reference images and their roles
prompt: I have three reference images. Image A: Mira's face and hair. Image B: her green wool coat. Image C: a small kitchen with a window on the left. Write a 6-second Veo prompt where Mira walks in and sets down her keys. She must wear exactly the coat from image B.
rubric: States what each reference controls, reinforces exact wardrobe once, keeps the kitchen layout and window position, and does not claim reference limits or syntax beyond what the Veo file documents.

title: Rules out generated text and extras by default
prompt: Write a 6-second Seedance prompt for a wide shot of dragon boat athletes preparing on a dock at midday. They wear red life jackets and carry wooden paddles. There is a banner and a scoreboard in the background.
rubric: Rules out generated text on the banner, scoreboard and life jackets by name, no subtitles, logos or watermarks, no music, distinct faces with no cloned people, plain wardrobe stated, background movement natural but small, one continuous shot. Does not ask for readable text unless the user did.

title: Camera quantified: follow shot with stated stability
prompt: Write a 6-second Seedance prompt. A young woman in a flour-dusted apron hurries out of a bakery onto a night street, phone pressed to her ear, heading toward the camera. Make the camera feel real but smooth.
rubric: Specifies shot size, lens look and depth of field, angle, composition, one camera move (tracking) with stated stability (slight natural sway, otherwise steady), eyeline and focus, who is in frame, and excludes zoom, whip and orbit. Does not stack camera moves. Respects the Seedance file (order rather than seconds, no invented limits).

title: Dialogue that does not fit the clip is flagged
prompt: Write a 4-second Veo shot. A woman in a green coat says exactly: "I found the letter in his coat, I read every page, and I know exactly who he has been meeting every Thursday night." Medium shot, kitchen.

checks.pattern: split|longer clip|longer than|does(n't| not) fit|too long|won't fit

rubric: Estimates the speech time (about 28 words, roughly 11 seconds at 2.5 words per second) against 4 seconds, says it does not fit, and proposes a longer clip or a split across clips with the line kept word for word. Does not compress or cut the line silently.

title: Full series-clip prompt with states, blocking and recorded dialogue
prompt: This is clip 2 of 6 in episode 3, 10 seconds, 9:16, for Seedance. I have a finished dialogue recording for one line, exactly 10 seconds long. Previous clip ended with Iwan (34, navy shirt, steel watch on his left wrist) leaving through the front door; Noor (31, sage-green linen shirt, silver ring on her right index finger) stands at the kitchen island facing north holding a cup of tea, a sealed cream envelope on the counter. In this clip Noor picks up the envelope, then Iwan comes back in and says: "That isn't yours to open." Write the full production prompt for this clip.
rubric: Follows the anatomy: references, recorded-dialogue rules (model does not voice or alter the line, lips only, picture changes not the recording), clip task, scene and light, appearance block with the identity anchors, opening state from the previous clip, blocking with a fixed landmark or compass, cuts with camera line, who is in frame, eyeline and focus, the exact line in a lip-sync window with delivery, ending state, ambient sound, numbered constraints including no readable text and no music, and a voice profile. Does not replay the previous action. Fits a sensible length.

title: Attach only what is in the clip
prompt: Clip 4 shows only Mira at the counter reading a letter. I have reference images for Mira, Daniel and the letter. Daniel appears in clip 5. Which images do I attach to clip 4, and write the prompt for Seedance, 6 seconds.
rubric: Says to attach Mira and the letter only, and leave Daniel's image out of clip 4 because a reference makes the model show that person; states that no one else is in frame; the prompt mentions neither Daniel's look nor an off-screen Daniel.
